task: Align Dockerfile builder to Go 1.26 and pin apk package versions in the runtime and builder stages (#26)

events.summary: Scoped to the Dockerfile builder FROM line and the two apk add lines (builder's git, runtime's five quota tools). go.mod (go 1.26.0), .github/workflows/ci.yaml (five go-version/go-version-input pins already at 1.26), and the chart's appVersion were confirmed already at 1.26 and left untouched -- this change removes the drift rather than moving the target. No other Dockerfile lines, no chart RBAC/privileged settings, and no application code were touched

Dockerfile builder FROM changed from golang:1.27-alpine@sha256:4c9fe60190a2a3350ddc51de80d0224b8a6698d12bdfc999fee45ea9d6c46dbc to golang:1.26-alpine@sha256:b6890e35ded5d19118c2bca3d7754dc4e6f694aac2d0aeb92f9807c2879e4230, resolved as the multi-arch manifest-list digest (covering linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 among other platforms, resolving to Go 1.26.8 on alpine3.24) via `docker buildx imagetools inspect golang:1.26-alpine` against the colima docker context on 2026-09-02 -- not a single-platform manifest digest. Both apk add lines were pinned to explicit name=version-release pairs resolved from a real build against the still digest-pinned alpine:3.24@sha256:28bd5fe8b56d1bd048e5babf5b10710ebe0bae67db86916198a6eec434943f8b base on the same date: builder stage git=2.54.0-r0; runtime stage xfsprogs-extra=7.0.1-r0, quota-tools=4.11-r0, e2fsprogs=1.47.4-r0, util-linux=2.42.1-r0, btrfs-progs=6.17.1-r1. A comment above each pinned RUN line states the pin date, that a pin vanishing from the Alpine 3.24 index fails the build loudly, and that a base digest bump is the moment to refresh them. Only the packages explicitly named on the apk add lines were pinned; their own dependencies (76 additional transitive packages in the runtime stage) are resolved by apk and already recorded in the existing /licenses/os-packages-manifest.txt logic, which was left unchanged

docker build --no-cache -t nfs-quota-agent:toolchain-check . succeeded end to end (builder compiled the binary under Go 1.26.8, runtime stage installed all five pinned packages with no version-resolution errors). `docker run --rm --entrypoint apk nfs-quota-agent:toolchain-check info -v` listed btrfs-progs-6.17.1-r1, e2fsprogs-1.47.4-r0, quota-tools-4.11-r0, util-linux-2.42.1-r0 and xfsprogs-extra-7.0.1-r0 -- exactly the pinned versions. `docker run --rm --entrypoint /nfs-quota-agent nfs-quota-agent:toolchain-check version` printed 'nfs-quota-agent version dev', confirming the binary runs. `docker build --target builder -t nfs-quota-agent:builder-check .` then `docker run --rm --entrypoint go nfs-quota-agent:builder-check version` printed 'go version go1.26.8 linux/arm64', confirming the builder stage. `make test` passed with zero FAIL lines across all packages (this change does not touch Go code, so this only guards against an unrelated regression)
events.scope: Dockerfile build correctness, installed package version pinning, binary startup, and builder toolchain version on the colima docker context (aarch64); does not exercise quota enforcement, which this change does not touch

events.summary: #26's two supply-chain-hardening items are done within the scope stated in e1 and at the evidence level in e3: the Dockerfile builder now matches go.mod and CI at Go 1.26, pinned via the golang:1.26-alpine multi-arch manifest-list digest, and every apk-installed package named on the apk add lines is pinned to the exact version the digest-pinned alpine:3.24 base resolved on 2026-09-02, with comments explaining the fail-loud-not-drift-silently intent and the refresh trigger
Complete at the build, installed-package-version, binary-startup, builder-toolchain and unrelated-test-suite level; nothing outstanding was deferred
